title: Favorite rags from the Red Book and what New Orleans bands played
summary: Love names the Red Book rags he likes best and says New Orleans bands each played only a few of them.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you, which of those rags do you like that you play from the Red Bull now?
Well I tell you I like them all. I played with one of them. But the best thing I liked, Frog Legs, Easy Winner, Chrysanthemum, Ophelia Ryan. They're real musical numbers.
What numbers did they like down here in New Orleans in holding times?
They didn't play so many of them.
They didn't play them all, just some of them.
